CustomField.description: The page's name. In page-by-page forms it is the navigation label, the page heading and the Back button's text on the following page; in Stages Mode it is the stage card title. The form also matches progress indicator clicks to pages by this label, so keep labels unique within a template.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A short title for this page, such as Personal Information. It shows in the progress indicator, as the page heading, and on the stage card in Stages Mode. Keep it unique within the template: the form matches progress indicator clicks to pages by this label.
CustomField.label: Page Label
